Quantum Computing Breakthrough Announced

Scientists at MIT have achieved a major milestone in quantum computing, demonstrating a 256-qubit processor with unprecedented stability.

Technical Details

The new chip uses superconducting circuits cooled to 15 millikelvin. Error rates are below 0.1% for single-qubit operations.

Implications

This advance could accelerate drug discovery by 10 years and revolutionize cryptography.
